section1_context: plan-manager is a local-first library for Markdown/MDX plans (plain files with YAML frontmatter under PLAN_HOME, default ~/notes/SecondBrain/4.Resources/plans). Three surfaces share one src/ tree: a TypeScript CLI (src/cli, src/lib) and a Go port (cli/) with a terminal UI; a localhost-only dashboard HTTP server implemented twice (src/server/server.ts on Node http, cli/internal/server on net/http), bound to 127.0.0.1 and serving byte-identical browser JS; and an optional private hosted viewer, a Next.js 16 App Router app (src/app, src/proxy.ts, src/hosted) deployed on Vercel with Clerk authentication, a Neon Postgres index, and private Vercel Blob storage for plan content. ~13.5k LOC. The hosted app is addressed at https://planmanager.hacker1db.dev and is intended for a single owner or a short Clerk allowlist; the CLI pushes plans to it over authenticated HTTPS. No IaC/CI/Docker is in-tree; deployment is Vercel Git-integration builds plus environment-variable secrets. The branch name feat/sveltekit-hosted is misleading: the app is still Next.js, and this checkout (97b8721) is 2 commits behind main.

section2_assets.description: Current + all historical plan Markdown/MDX in private Vercel Blob (plans/<id>/<revision>.md) plus the plan_versions index; immutable, no purge path
Neon plans + cli_tokens + plan_versions rows; no owner/tenant column, all allowlisted owners share everything
PLAN_MANAGER_TOKEN_PEPPER, prepended to every pm_ secret before scrypt; DB write + pepper => forge tokens
CLERK_SECRET_KEY; full backend control of the Clerk instance, enough to impersonate an owner
DATABASE_URL (single shared role, runtime+migrate+local); full read/write/DDL
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN; store-wide read/overwrite/delete bypassing all app auth
PLAN_MANAGER_OWNER_CLERK_USER_IDS (+ legacy singular fallback) and PLAN_MANAGER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID; the only authZ control
pm_ bearer tokens (unbounded expiry) and Clerk OAuth access/refresh credential; grant hosted write to every plan
.env.local / .env.production.local / .temp.values.txt pulled via vercel env pull (0644 in sibling checkout)
Owner macOS account: login Keychain, gh auth, SSH keys, other repos; tool shells out to editor/opener/pandoc/gh/security
Canonical plan files under PLAN_HOME + archive/; written by CLIs, TUI, dashboard, agents, sync
Default PLAN_HOME is inside the user's SecondBrain Obsidian vault; tool must never read/write outside PLAN_HOME
dist/ build, bin/plan, Go binary, embedded dashboard; whoever edits them gets persistent code execution as the user
Unauthenticated 127.0.0.1:4173 API: read bodies+absolute paths, mutate, open-in-editor
Vercel/Neon/Blob/Clerk quotas; no rate limiting, unbounded version growth, per-search full-blob reads
No audit log for token mint/revoke, push, status change; only platform logs
